learn.hook: Hot, wet, cold or full of flowers? Every season is different!
points: Summer is hot. The sun shines bright.
The rainy season brings dark clouds and lots of rain.
After the rains, autumn comes. Then comes winter, which is cold.
Spring comes after winter. Many plants have new leaves and flowers.
The seasons come again and again, every year.

example.q: Read the poem: "Summer sun is hot and bright. Rainy clouds bring rain at night. Winter mornings, cold and grey. Spring brings flowers, hip hooray!" Which season brings flowers?
steps: Find the word flowers in the poem.
The line is: Spring brings flowers.
So spring brings flowers.

learn.reallife: We eat cool mangoes in summer, jump in puddles in the rainy season and drink hot soup in winter.

games.title: Season after season
games.prompt: Start with summer. Which season comes next?

games.title: Seasons: true or false?
items: In summer, the sun is very hot.
It rains a lot in the rainy season.
That is why it is called the rainy season.
After the cold winter, spring comes.
There is only one season in a year.
A year has many seasons, one after another.

quiz.q: Read: "Summer sun is hot and bright." What is the summer sun like?
quiz.explain: The line says the summer sun is hot and bright.
steps: Read the line: summer sun is hot and bright.
So the summer sun is hot and bright. Cold and grey is winter.

quiz.q: Read: "Winter mornings, cold and grey." Which season has cold mornings?
quiz.explain: The line says winter mornings are cold.
steps: Read the line: winter mornings, cold and grey.
So winter has cold mornings.

quiz.q: Read: "Rainy clouds bring rain at night." What do the clouds bring?
quiz.explain: The line says rainy clouds bring rain.
steps: Read the line: rainy clouds bring rain at night.
So the clouds bring rain.
quiz.mistake: Guesses instead of reading the line

quiz.q: Read: "Summer sun is hot and bright." Which word rhymes with bright?
quiz.explain: Bright and night both end with the sound -ight.
steps: Bright ends with the sound -ight.
Night also ends with -ight. So night rhymes with bright.
quiz.mistake: Picks any word from the line

steps: Winter is cold.
Spring comes after winter, with new leaves and flowers.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the order of seasons

quiz.q: Which is the opposite of hot?
steps: Hot and cold are opposites.
Warm is close to hot, so it is not the opposite.
Answer: Cold
quiz.mistake: Picks a word with a similar meaning

teach.ask: Gappu: What are seasons? Is it always hot?
teach.praise: Sunny, rainy, chilly or flowery - I know them all now!
teach.nudge: Which season is hot and which is cold?

revise.summary: Summer is hot, the rainy season brings rain, autumn comes after the rains, winter is cold, and spring brings new leaves and flowers. The seasons come again every year.
focus: Know what each season is like
Know which season comes after winter
Read a line of a poem and find rhyming words
remember: Summer: hot. Rainy season: rain. Winter: cold. Spring: flowers.
traps: Don't mix up summer (hot) and winter (cold).
Warm is not the opposite of hot. Cold is.

learn.hook: Would you wear a sweater on a hot day? No way!
points: Weather words: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, hot and cold.
On hot days we wear light cotton clothes and a cap.
On rainy days we use a raincoat and an umbrella.
On cold days we wear a woollen sweater, a cap and socks.
We dress to keep our body comfortable.

example.q: Think it through: It is raining hard. Tara has to go to school. What should she take?
steps: Rain will make her wet.
A raincoat or an umbrella keeps us dry.
So Tara should take an umbrella or wear a raincoat.

learn.reallife: In Delhi winters, children wear sweaters to school. In Chennai summers, they wear light cotton clothes.

items.q: When rain falls, the day is ___
When the sun shines, the day is ___
We hold it over our head in rain
A warm top made of wool

quiz.q: It is a cold winter morning. What should Rohan wear?
quiz.explain: Woollen clothes keep us warm when it is cold.
steps: It is a cold morning.
A woollen sweater keeps us warm.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up clothes for hot and cold weather

quiz.q: It is a very hot summer day. What is best to wear?
quiz.explain: Cotton clothes are light and cool for hot days.
steps: It is a very hot day.
Light cotton clothes keep us cool. Woollen clothes are for cold days.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up clothes for hot and cold weather

quiz.q: What do we use to stay dry in the rain?
quiz.explain: An umbrella keeps the rain off us.
steps: Rain makes us wet.
An umbrella keeps the rain off us.
quiz.mistake: Does not match the thing to the weather

quiz.q: Read: "The wind blows the kites high in the sky." What is the weather like?
quiz.explain: Wind blowing hard means it is windy.
steps: The clue word is wind.
When the wind blows hard, it is windy.
quiz.mistake: Does not use the clue word wind

quiz.q: 🌧️ Which is the right spelling for water falling from clouds?
steps: Say the letters: r-a-i-n.
So the spelling is rain.
quiz.mistake: Writes the word the way it sounds

quiz.q: The sky is full of dark clouds. Which word fits?
quiz.explain: When clouds cover the sky, it is cloudy.
steps: The clue is dark clouds in the sky.
When clouds cover the sky, it is cloudy.
quiz.mistake: Does not use the clue in the sentence

teach.ask: Gappu: It is cold outside! What should I wear? What about when it rains?
teach.praise: Brrr... I am wearing my sweater now! Thank you!
teach.nudge: What do I wear when it is cold or rainy?

revise.summary: Weather can be sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, hot or cold. We wear cotton on hot days, a raincoat or umbrella on rainy days and woollens on cold days.
focus: Pick the right clothes for the weather
Use clue words to name the weather
remember: Hot day: light cotton clothes and a cap
Cold day: woollen sweater, cap and socks
traps: Don't mix up clothes for hot and cold days.
Don't miss the clue word: wind means windy, dark clouds mean cloudy.
